SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.    File No..........
Section 1, Special Branch Station /
REPORT
Date November 4, 1938

Subject Communication dated 28-10-38 from Major C.J.Corbin,S.V.C., concerning
J.G.Vantchurin.

Made by D.S.I. Prokofiev. Forwarded by C Crawford

〔此处转录不清〕

Enquiries show that Joseph George VANTCHURIN was
born in 1891 at Shuya,Vladimir Province,Russia. He is report-
ed to have arrived in Shanghai from Vladivostok in 1918. Here
he was employed with the Russo-Asiatic Bank,15 The Bund, as
an Assistant Exchange Manager until 1927 when the bank went
into liquidation. In 1929-1930 he was connected with Bleeker &
Weyler, Bill and Bullion Brokers,4 Kiukiang Road, and in 1931-
1932 was a partner in the " Commonwealth Products Co.," ( Im-
porters of Australian Products),72 Szechuen Road. Severing his
partnership with this firm in September,1932,he established the
"Australian Produce Co.," at 6 Kiukiang Road,which was later
removed to 320 Szechuen Road. This firm existed from 1932 to
1934. He is reported to have been investing capital in cer-
tain other commercial enterprises in Shanghai during the pe-
riod from 1927 to 1935. It appears that on the whole he was
not successful in his commercial activities and lost a con-
siderable amount of capital. In 1935 he is reported to have
left for Hongkong.

Vantchurin is registered with the Russian Emigrants'
Committee,118/1 Moulmein Road. His wife, Mrs Anna Mihailovna
Vantchurin nee Eichenbaum still resides in Shanghai together
with children,her present address being 1377 Avenue Road,
Apt. 315. She is the daughter of a Russian of Jewish origin
named M.B.Eichenbaum,local merchant, who is reported to have
died in October,1935 at Hongkong.

While in Shanghai Vantchurin did not come to the no-
tice of the Municipal Police in connection with any activities
of an undesirable character,except that in 1931,in connection

日期：1938年11月4日

事由：关于J.G.Vantchurin，S.V.C.（上海义勇军）C.J.Corbin少校于1938年10月28日来函。

由警探长Prokofiev撰写。由C Crawford转呈

〔此处转录不清〕

经查，Joseph George VANTCHURIN于1891年出生于俄罗斯弗拉基米尔省舒亚市。据报他于1918年从符拉迪沃斯托克抵达上海。此后他在外滩15号的华俄银行任职助理汇兑经理，直至1927年该银行清算。1929至1930年间，他与九江路4号的票据与金银经纪商Bleeker & Weyler公司有关联；1931至1932年间，他是四川路72号“Commonwealth Products Co.”（澳大利亚产品进口商）的合伙人。1932年9月，他终止了与该公司的合伙关系，并在九江路6号成立了“Australian Produce Co.”，后迁至四川路320号。该公司存续时间为1932年至1934年。据报在1927年至1935年期间，他曾向上海的其他一些商业企业投资资本。看来总体而言，他的商业活动并不成功，损失了大量资本。据报他于1935年前往香港。

Vantchurin已在莫利爱路118/1号的俄国侨民委员会登记。其妻Anna Mihailovna Vantchurin夫人（娘家姓Eichenbaum）携子女仍居住在上海，现住址为爱文义路1377号315室。她是俄籍犹太裔商人M.B.Eichenbaum的女儿，据报M.B.Eichenbaum于1935年10月在香港去世。

Vantchurin在上海期间，除1931年因涉及警方对叶茨路90号“International Merchants' Club”（国际商人俱乐部） premises 的突击搜查及其后的调查外，并未因任何不良行为引起工部局警务处的注意。在该俱乐部内曾进行公开赌博活动，

October 19th, 1938.

Dear Major Corbin,

Since we left Shanghai in April, we have had
eleven hectic weeks in London and are now settled here
until April, 1940, so please make a note of our address
and do not fail to let us know if ever you have a chance
of coming to Manila. A spare bed is permanently at
your disposal.

Incidentally this is also the address of the
Wellborns, with whom you travelled across the Pacific;
they send their greetings and enclose a letter.

I remember that Marvyn Reynolds once offered
to look up some individual for me in the S.M.C. Police
files and wonder whether you could possibly do the same
thing. In a factory which we are acquiring, we will
inherit an employee called J. A. Vantchurin, who is
alleged to have come to Shanghai in 1918, to have been
Assistant Exchange Manager of the Russo-Asiatic Bank
until it closed down about 1926. He then stayed
for a few years in Shanghai, went to Hongkong and finally
came to Manila in 1936. He is said to have a wife
and family living in Avenue Road, Shanghai. At present,
the poor man is doing a menial job for £180 per annum
and he seems to us by all accounts to be thinking of some-
thing better. Before promoting him, we would however
like to verify his record, as if his police record was

菲律宾马尼拉Isaac Peral路1035号

1938年10月19日。

亲爱的Corbin少校：

自从我们四月离开上海以来，我们在伦敦度过了十一周忙碌的日子，现已在此安顿下来，直至1940年4月，因此请记下我们的地址，若您有机会来马尼拉，请务必告知。这里常备有一张空床供您使用。

顺便提一下，这也是Wellborn夫妇的地址，您曾与他们一同横渡太平洋；他们向您致意，并随信附上一封信。

我记得Marvyn Reynolds曾提出帮我在工部局警务处档案中查询某个人，不知您是否也能做同样的事。在我们即将收购的一家工厂里，我们将接收一名叫J. A. Vantchurin的员工，据说他于1918年来到上海，在华俄银行担任助理汇兑经理，直至该银行约于1926年关闭。随后他在上海停留了几年，去了香港，最终于1936年来到马尼拉。据说他的妻子和家人住在上海的爱文义路。目前，这个可怜的人做着卑微的工作，年薪180英镑，据各方面消息看，他似乎正考虑寻求更好的发展。但在提拔他之前，我们希望核实他的履历，因为如果他的警务记录能

pages.en:
- 2 -

confirm his story and tell us anything either for
or against him, it would be most useful as he is
naturally an unknown quantity to us at present.

I do apologize for bothering you in this
way and hope that it will not be much trouble.

Please remember me to Col. Hornby and say
that we hope to see him here some time.

Life here is hot but peaceful and we are
spared the alarms and excitements which you no doubt
still have.

With very best wishes, I am,

Yours sincerely,

A. B. Butler.

证实他的说法，并告诉我们任何对他有利或不利的信息，那将非常有用，因为目前他对我们要说自然是个未知数。

对于以此事打扰您，我深表歉意，希望这不会给您带来太多麻烦。

请代我向Hornby上校问好，并说我们希望将来能在此见到他。

这里的生活炎热但平静，我们免受了你们无疑仍在经历的警报和动荡。

致以最美好的祝愿，

您真诚的，

A. B. Butler.

November 7, 38.

Major C.J. Corbin,
S. V. C.

Dear Corbin,

With reference to your letter dated October
28, 1938, I forward herewith a copy of the informa-
tion obtained regarding J.A. Vantolurin. Nothing
in it is detrimental to his character and there
is no reason why you should not forward it to
your friend in Manila.

Mr. Butler's letter is returned as requested.

Yours sincerely,

〔此处转录不清〕

EB/

按要求退回Butler先生的信件。
